queries: WITH event_averages AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.status, AVG(b.remaining) AS avg_remaining, AVG(1.0 * (b.spent - b.amount) / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS avg_overspend_rate FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id GROUP BY e.event_id, e.status) SELECT status, AVG(avg_remaining) AS average_remaining, AVG(avg_overspend_rate) AS average_overspend_rate, AVG(avg_remaining) / NULLIF((SELECT AVG(avg_remaining) FROM event_averages), 0) AS remaining_to_overall_ratio FROM event_averages GROUP BY status;

WITH event_averages AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.status, AVG(b.remaining) AS avg_remaining, AVG((b.spent - b.amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS avg_overspend_rate FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id GROUP BY e.event_id, e.status), status_averages AS (SELECT status, AVG(avg_remaining) AS avg_remaining, AVG(avg_overspend_rate) AS avg_overspend_rate FROM event_averages GROUP BY status), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining) AS avg_remaining FROM event_averages) SELECT s.status, s.avg_remaining, s.avg_overspend_rate, s.avg_remaining / NULLIF(o.avg_remaining, 0) AS remaining_ratio FROM status_averages AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o

responses.sql: WITH event_averages AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.status, AVG(b.remaining) AS avg_remaining, AVG(1.0 * (b.spent - b.amount) / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS avg_overspend_rate FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id GROUP BY e.event_id, e.status) SELECT status, AVG(avg_remaining) AS average_remaining, AVG(avg_overspend_rate) AS average_overspend_rate, AVG(avg_remaining) / NULLIF((SELECT AVG(avg_remaining) FROM event_averages), 0) AS remaining_to_overall_ratio FROM event_averages GROUP BY status;

assumptions.assumption: An overspend rate with a zero budget amount is undefined and is omitted from the average. The overall remaining average gives each matched event equal weight.
